title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 30: Communication in the future (Set 3)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Communication in the future (Set 3) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Communication in the future (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Read the dialogue and choose the correct option that best fits each of the blanks. Emma: Hi, Jake! How do you think people will communicate in the future? Jake: Hi, Emma! I think smart devices will 12.1 respond speak to our voices and perform tasks instantly. Emma: That sounds amazing! Maybe phones will 12.2 disappear replace , and we will talk using holograms. Jake: Yes! And instead of typing, we might send a 12.3 voice message text message just by thinking. Emma: That would be so fast! Maybe there will be no 12.4 emoji button , and everything will work by touch. Jake: I agree! The future of communication will be easier and more exciting!

You may make any changes to the words if necessary. roll adjust technology device button smartphone In the future, 13.1 will completely change the way people communicate. Smart 13.2 will have voice-controlled systems, so people will only need to speak to give commands. The systems will understand and do tasks automatically. Future 13.3 will have flexible screens that people can 13.4 to make them smaller and easier to carry like small papers. They also will not need 13.5 , as users will control everything with voice commands or gestures. Meetings and conversations will also change. Smart assistants will 13.6 volume, screen brightness, or language settings automatically. Communication therefore will be smoother, which helps people stay focused without worrying about small details.
